falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes below 4950 on any daily session
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern relied on a higher low structure; a close below this threshold breaks the fractal similarity and invalidates the 77% pattern match, proving the bottom call false

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 39 assumes contained volatility; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic escalation rather than exhaustion, contradicting the bottoming signal and suggesting continuation lower

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops more than 40 bps from current level within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A rapid rates collapse of this magnitude signals flight-to-safety distress, not the orderly bottoming the pattern predicts; this would indicate macro breakdown rather than the August 2024-style stabilization

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
